key_insight: c0PPO improves value estimation for multi-step math reasoning by letting the critic compare a rollout against verified same-prompt successes and failures, instead of relying only on the current state.
engineering_relevance: This gives RLVR training a more reliable credit-assignment signal for LLM reasoning, which can stabilize online optimization without changing the deployment-time policy interface.
method: Reuse verified same-prompt rollouts as contrastive evidence for the critic
Keep standard actor-critic policy optimization unchanged
Use the self-privileged setup even with smaller asymmetric critics
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that c0PPO substantially improves value-estimation quality and outperforms representative actor-critic and critic-free RLVR baselines on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
watch_item: The approach depends on access to verified same-prompt rollouts, so training cost and data generation/selection quality may become practical bottlenecks.
paper_title: Privy to the Foil: Recasting Value Estimation with a Self-Privileged Critic for RLVR
